name: s81hd_lane_adp_p8f

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered, unchanged RTL (release freeze): core face tx_d -> txd_p, tx_v -> 2 kept ot_s81hd_kf flops, rx_v / rx_d / flt from flops; lane face lo_v / lo_d (slice lv / ld) and li_r (cr_q) and r_lane / r_misc_o (relay leaves) leave flops, lo_r -> 2 kept kf flops, li_d -> rd_q, lf -> flt_q; only li_v feeds the 4-bit sender-credit check before its flop. A recipe pin stage would change the frozen latency contract.

reset_landing.reason: rst_n lands in 2 ck flops at the core face, then ot_rst_relay_tree3 (35 slice leaves + lane + rx + misc, every leaf <= ~32 reset pins); the child lands its own rs (tree3 inside the closed view)

fill_reason.pin_bound: pin-bound: 1,1xx pins per face over the lane child's 583.2-um E face (W) and the parent's core face (E); std ~2.6k um2; never shrink.

structural_change: s81hd_lane_adp (STW-S81c-COLLA2-VP 10-22, HEAD lane design (b), steward decision): the static core adapter of ot_s81hd_lane hardened as its OWN child with its own CTS (p3m..p7m: one parent root could not land the adapter's pin flops on the child's routed boundary at both TT and FF -- 698.4 TT 28 / FF 115, 743.4 61.5 / 85.2, p7m FF 91). Same registers and edges (rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_head/ot_s81hd_lane_ha.sv: hierarchy only; bench PASS, OVF/RP mutants caught). The parent becomes 2 hard children (lane view + this view) with a register->register landed seam on facing W/E pins at identical y; no soft pin flops under the parent root. FB: 108-um wide adapter (lower std/pin-flop density, wider rows for the 35 slices).

job.purpose: HEAD lane (b): hardened static adapter child (FB) for s81hd_lane_p8m/p8f
